claims: %N A382485 a(n) = ceiling(n/d^2) where d is the largest divisor of n which is not greater than the square root of n.
%C A382485 Conjecture: There exists some constant, k, approximately equal to 1.2, such that a(n) is of average order k*n/log(n). See Tooth Link for evidence.
%H A382485 Robert Israel, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..10000
%H A382485 Clive Tooth, [Sum_{i=2..n} a(i)]/[Sum_{i=2..n} i/log(i)] for n=10^7 to 10^9
